americancurl: An American curl cat seen from a THREE-QUARTER FRONT VIEW, facing toward the viewer and slightly turned - its face and chest are visible and it is NOT seen from behind. A medium silky-coated cat whose one distinguishing feature is its EARS: each ear rises upright and firm from a wide base, and then THE WHOLE UPPER HALF OF THE EAR BENDS SMOOTHLY BACKWARD IN ONE GENTLE ARC, so the tip of the ear points back toward the crown of the skull - like a backward-leaning crescent or a raised eyebrow shape. This is a SINGLE SMOOTH BACKWARD BEND OF THE WHOLE EAR, NOT a spiral, NOT a rolled-up scroll, NOT a decorative loop or curl shape anywhere on the ear - the ear stays open and firm along its whole length, simply arcing backward, with no coiled or rolled section at the tip. It has EXACTLY ONE TAIL, a single plumed tail and no more. Sitting upright. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
